subject: general
question: Which of the following is a folk dance from the state of Maharashtra?
solution:
The correct answer is **Dhangari Gaja**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dhangari Gaja** is a traditional folk dance from the state of Maharashtra.
 
• This dance is primarily performed by the Dhangar community, who are shepherds by profession.
 
• The dance is performed to please the Hindu god Biruba, who is the deity of the Dhangar community.<
